claim: The single-wave leaf at rows 2-128 is extended from (5120,17408) to (5120,10240) and (5120,12288), both bit-identical and 1.02x-1.28x faster than the 256-row shared-B owner. The four dense shapes where single-wave is measurably slower are recorded as measured losses so nobody re-opens them.
hardware: epyc / AMD Radeon Pro W7900 gfx1100 / Ryzen 9 5950X
command: .venv/bin/python scripts/gguf_t16_prefill_row_sweep.py --all-shapes --rows 2,6,16,35,48,67,128,192 --reps 15 --warmup 4 --output /tmp/he-t16/shapes.json, then the same tool with --in-features 5120 --out-features 12288 --rows 67,80,96,112,128 and --out-features 10240 --rows 96,128,144,160
protocol: Canonical repack_gguf_q4_k_tile16 payloads over a valid Q4_K block image, one weight upload per shape, wall around one launch plus device_synchronize, two passes per arm, best-of-two, ratios are shared_b/single_wave so >1.0 means single-wave is faster, worst BF16 ULP distance recorded against the shared-B output, outputs finite.
ulp_vs_shared_b: 0 at every row and every shape measured

promoted.row6_routes_untouched: both shapes are in GGUF_Q4_T16_PHYSICAL_C1_ROWTILE_SHAPES and the row-6 branch is checked first, so their measured 7.28x and 7.32x rows6 rowtile wins are preserved

first_token_ab.protocol: public hipengine.LLM API, production profile, one 35-token suite prompt, max_tokens=1, third-iteration steady state, same build, HIPENGINE_GGUF_Q4_T16_SINGLE_WAVE_MAX_ROWS=0 to disable all three shapes
first_token_ab.note: the two new shapes add ~2.2 ms on top of the -7.75% already banked for (5120,17408), which is small because the 35-token prompt admits few rows through those projections

down_projection_is_the_remaining_gap.reading: it is the most expensive dense launch in the prefill wall and 1.7x slower than gate/up on the same 51.5 MB of weights, because out_features=5120 gives the shared-B grid only ~107 column blocks against 512 compute units, so the launch cannot saturate memory. No registered leaf beats it: single-wave is 0.77x-0.83x and the rows6 rowtile is neutral outside row 6. Closing it needs a split-K or column-resplit kernel, which is new kernel work with its own RED gate, not a declaration.
down_projection_is_the_remaining_gap.other_measured_losses: (5120,6144), (6144,5120) and (5120,1024) have no registered leaf that beats shared-B at these rows either; their owners cost 0.30-0.49 ms.

gates.red_first: tests/test_gguf_q4_k_t16_dense.py failed on the three-shape policy set before the shapes were added
gates.numerics: bit-exact at every measured row and shape, so no KL/top-1 gate was required for the changed leaves
gates.fallback: shared-B remains the registered strict sibling; HIPENGINE_GGUF_Q4_T16_SINGLE_WAVE_MAX_ROWS=0 disables the whole band on the same build

scratch_hygiene: Sweep JSON stays in /tmp/he-t16; only the ratios and this summary are committed.
